researchQuestion: Does three consecutive same-sign published lodging CPI MoM readings warn that next Shelter CPI 3-month-average forecast error exceeds 0.15 percentage points?
decision: The held-out experiment did not show a higher large-miss frequency for flagged cases; never use this rule to boost confidence or trade.

reliability.reason: 2 of 8 flagged >0.15pp misses versus 5 of 19 nonflagged, 25.0% versus 26.3%. Difference small and opposite sign for large-miss frequency; n=27.

limitations: Historical ALFRED first-vintage monthly shelter index and ex-ante lodging readings, not rounded published BLS values
27 eligible cases, 4 skipped release candidates; inadequate power to prove small effects
This study predicts risk of 3-month average Shelter forecast error, not direction of hotel change nor all-items CPI
No out-of-sample evidence for improving full CPI/Core CPI V2 forecast
